text: This Greenlandic delicacy might be surprising and seem like simply a novelty to foreigners, but in reality, it's a symbol of survival in the brutal Nordic winters.

author: Krista Watson
text: Almost every single person in this South American town is involved in making these traditional hats in some way or another. That's because a sombrero vueltiao is a symbol of national pride, a testament of the town's skillful craftsmanship, and a way of telling a person's unique story.
title: Tuchín, the Colombian Town Known for Its Colorful, Historical Hats

author: Krista Watson
text: These brave, athletic women partake in a long tradition of diving for pearls up to 80 feet deep in the ocean. Many are able to hold their breath for up to 2 minutes, making them virtual mermaids.
title: The Japanese Women Who Are Almost Mermaids

author: Krista Watson
text: These creepy kids with impossibly large, melon-shaped heads haunt America's forests. Some say they eat human flesh, while others say they just want to stay hidden and are simply mutant creatures who never grow old.
title: The Melon-Headed Children Roaming U.S. Forests

author: Krista Watson
text: This picturesque Austrian lake is unusual for one reason: it disappears for part of the year. After vanishing for several months, it returns in the summer and swallows a nearby park, creating a dazzling underground world straight out of a fantasy novel.
title: The Vanishing Austrian Lake with a Park Underneath
